summary.zh: 桌面分组、文件磁贴与 AI 收纳的公开测试版。
summary.en: Public test of desktop groups, file tiles and AI organization.

description.zh: 将桌面文件分组并以磁贴展示，提供 AI 收纳、桌面体检与外观设置。公开测试版，建议先在非关键桌面测试。Pulse 1.0.60 支持基础桌面功能；工作台、托盘、搜索与 Shell 菜单增强依赖更新的主程序，旧版会降级。
description.en: Groups desktop files and displays tiles, with AI organization, health checks and appearance settings. Public test. Pulse 1.0.60 supports core desktop features; workbench, tray, search and Shell-menu enhancements require a newer host and degrade on older hosts.

notes.zh: 首个公开测试版：桌面分组、文件磁贴、AI收纳及桌面外观设置。
notes.en: First public test: desktop groups, file tiles, AI organization and desktop appearance settings.
